fusions.name: Buffet
fusions.desc: Beats the air flat against everything near you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rim Strike
fusions.desc: A hard edge-first blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Glancing Blow
fusions.desc: When an enemy strikes you, a ward absorbs damage equal to 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
